description.value: Prata-Man Singapore Cuisine is a Singaporean restaurant in Richmond, BC, specializing in Hainanese Chicken, Roti/Prata bread, Laksa, Mee Goreng, and other Southeast Asian staples presented in a bilingual English-Chinese menu. The restaurant offers online ordering for quick pickup, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Capstan Way area of Richmond.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM phone number (+1 604-278-1348). The site confirms the business is an active Singaporean restaurant at 9060 Capstan Wy, Richmond, with online ordering for pickup. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; takeout/pickup is explicitly offered and some vegetarian-friendly items (tofu dish, vegetable stir-fries) appear on the menu.
concerns: OSM record has no address field; address 9060 Capstan Wy, Richmond, BC V6X3N6 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active Singaporean restaurant with takeout, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to determine whether it meets minimum WWC listing requirements.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetarian-friendly items: Tohu Goreng (tofu dish), Stir Fried Pea Tip with Garlic, Stir Fried Lettuce with Garlic. No explicit vegan or GF labeling
